meta.description: Ceramic coating, window tint, paint correction and detailing at our Clinton Township shop on 14 Mile Road near Kelly. Appointment only. Mobile and valet too.

hero.title: Home is **14 Mile and Kelly.**
hero.lede: Refresh My Ride is a Clinton Township shop: 33115 Louise Ave, on the north side of 14 Mile Road just east of Kelly Road. Ceramic coating, window tint and paint correction are done here, indoors. Detailing can be done here, in your driveway or by valet. Appointment only, Monday to Friday.

about.title: Three corridors, one river, no downtown.
body: Clinton Township runs from 14 Mile Road at its south edge to Hall Road at the north, with Fraser and Mount Clemens carved out of what began as a standard six mile square. It has no traditional downtown. The township is known by three corridors, Groesbeck Highway, Gratiot Avenue and Hall Road, and the three branches of the Clinton River come together inside its borders.

Most trips here end up on one of the township's heaviest traveled roads: I-94, Hall Road, Gratiot, Groesbeck, Metropolitan Parkway, Hayes or Garfield. Here is what that does to a vehicle, and what we do about it.

points.title: Salt on the main roads, snow on your street
points.body: The county road department clears state and primary roads first. Inside subdivisions it salts only at entrances, exits, intersections and hills. So the salt on your rocker panels and floor mats came off Gratiot, Groesbeck, Hall Road or Metropolitan Parkway. It stays there until it is washed off the paint and extracted from the carpet.

points.title: Driveways across most of the township
points.body: Single-family homes take up the largest share of the township's land, mostly in platted subdivisions and site condominium developments. A driveway with room to walk the full perimeter of the vehicle is all a mobile detail needs. Apartment and condo complexes cluster along Hayes Road, Garfield Road and 19 Mile Road. There, tell us about the parking first.

points.title: Dogs, parks and the Clinton River
points.body: The township runs a 1.5 acre fenced dog park, The Mall at Partridge Creek welcomes dogs, and George George Memorial Park has a kayak and canoe launch on the Clinton River. Dog hair, river mud and wet gear end up in the back of the car. Steam and hot water extraction are how they come back out.

points.title: A cruise on Gratiot every August
points.body: The Clinton Township Gratiot Cruise runs Gratiot Avenue between 14 Mile Road and Wellington Crescent on the first Sunday in August. Parked in full sun with people walking past, paint shows every swirl mark. Paint correction machine polishes them out of the clear coat, and it is done before any ceramic coating goes on.

logistics.title: The shop is in town. Mobile and valet still come to you.
body: We are at 33115 Louise Ave, on the north side of 14 Mile Road just east of Kelly Road. That corner is the south edge of the township: Fraser is across Kelly Road and Roseville is across 14 Mile. From the north end, take Garfield Road south to 14 Mile Road and turn east. Louise Ave is on the left after Kelly Road. From Gratiot, turn west on 14 Mile. From the Civic Center on Romeo Plank Road it is about 6 miles, roughly 15 minutes without traffic.

The shop is appointment only, Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm, and closed on weekends. We are often out on mobile and valet jobs, so call or text (586) 400-1303 or book online before you head over. Online booking is open 24/7, and with an appointment we will have a bay ready for you.

Living close does not mean you have to make the trip. Interior, exterior and full details can be done at your home or workplace, and we bring our own power and water. Ceramic coating, window tint and paint correction need the shop's enclosed bays and controlled lighting. For those, valet picks the vehicle up, we do the work at the shop, and we bring it back. On coating jobs your Uber is covered for the drop-off and pickup.

faq.q: Where is your shop in Clinton Township?
faq.a: 33115 Louise Ave, Clinton Township, MI 48035. Louise Ave is on the north side of 14 Mile Road, just east of Kelly Road and west of Gratiot. From the Civic Center on Romeo Plank Road that is about 6 miles, roughly 15 minutes without traffic. It is a 2,000 square foot indoor shop and it is appointment only, so book before you come by.

faq.q: Can I stop in without an appointment?
faq.a: Please book first. We are appointment only, and the crew is often out on mobile and valet jobs. Call or text (586) 400-1303 Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm, or book online at any hour. With an appointment, a bay is ready for your vehicle when you pull in.

faq.q: I live a few minutes away. Do you still offer mobile detailing and valet here?
faq.a: Yes, both. Mobile detailing is done at your home or workplace with our own power and water. We need a driveway or a parking spot with room to walk the full perimeter of the vehicle, which matters most at apartment and condo lots. If the space is tight, valet is the answer: we pick the vehicle up, detail it at the shop and bring it back. See [how mobile and valet work](/mobile-detailing/).

faq.q: Which services have to be done at the shop?
faq.a: Ceramic coating, window tint and paint correction. All three need enclosed bays and controlled lighting, and a coating has to cure in the shop before the vehicle goes back outside. Detailing is the one service that can come to you. For [ceramic coating](/ceramic-coating/), plan on leaving the vehicle with us for at least a full day. We cover your Uber for the drop-off and pickup on coating jobs.

faq.q: What do detailing and window tint cost?
faq.a: Prices are listed for a coupe or sedan in average condition. [Detailing](/car-detailing-services-clinton-township-mi/) is from $139.99 for a Wash & Seal, from $184.99 for a Premium Interior Detail and from $249.99 for an Essential Refresh, inside and out. [Window tint](/window-tint-clinton-township-mi/) is from $99.99 for the front two windows in Geoshield C2 Carbon film. SUVs and trucks are quoted for their size. Ceramic coating is quoted per vehicle, so request a free quote and tell us what you drive.
